posts.name: AlexxKay
posts.cooked: If you look at the keywords of all the GWVoss/Dok'Thorath cards, it seems "Thorathian" (at least when used AS a keyword) is not merely a racial identifier, but a professional one as well: it refers exclusively to members of the military (excluding enslaved military, which are "Minion"s).  SS's bio only mentions her as a rebel, with no mention of ever having been part of the military, so it makes sense that she wouldn't have that keyword.

posts.cooked:
I love that your link asks the question, and the answer is no (because the link has an extra space at the end of it).

Is Sky-Scraper a Thorathian in the lore? Yes.

Is she a Thorathian in the game mechanics? No.

posts.name: LACK OF SUBTLETY
posts.cooked: My in-world explanation has been that while she is defintely of the Thoratian race, the game term "Thoratian" seems to apply to the Thoratians who are loyal to Voss, who see her as a traitor/outsider. Therefore, she is freely targeted and does not receive any of the benefits of being "Thoratian".
